externalSources.fact: @receptron/laya 0.1.2 dist/laya.js Laya.load(opts) uses path.resolve(opts.modelDir) when opts.modelDir is set and otherwise calls ensureBundle(opts); it reads laya_config.json, tokenizer/tokenizer.json and tokenizer/tokenizer_config.json from that directory with JSON.parse, builds new Tokenizer(tokenizerJson, tokenizerConfig) from @huggingface/tokenizers, throws unless [CLS], [SEP], [MASK] and [PAD] are tokens, and opens ort.InferenceSession.create(<modelDir>/laya.onnx, { executionProviders: opts.executionProviders ?? ["cpu"], graphOptimizationLevel: "all", ...opts.sessionOptions }), so opts.sessionOptions can override the execution providers; close() calls session.release()

@receptron/laya 0.1.2 dist/download.js ensureBundle(opts) fetches laya.onnx, laya.onnx.data, laya_config.json, tokenizer/tokenizer.json and tokenizer/tokenizer_config.json from https://huggingface.co/<opts.repo or receptron/laya-onnx>/resolve/<opts.revision or main>/<file> with redirect "follow", adds Authorization: Bearer <opts.token or HF_TOKEN> when either is set, and writes into opts.cacheDir or LAYA_CACHE or <XDG_CACHE_HOME or ~/.cache>/receptron-laya; the module's top level only imports node built-ins and defines constants and functions, so importing it performs no I/O

@receptron/laya 0.1.2 dist/sequence.js buildSequence lays a question out as [CLS] "<type> question: <instructions>" [SEP], then [MASK] and the text of each option, then [SEP] <state> [SEP], after replacing every literal "[MASK]" in instructions, options and state with a space; it encodes each option as " " + text cut to 48 tokens, cuts every option to max(4, floor((head_max_len - 16) / options)) tokens when head_max_len minus the options' total is below 16, cuts the instructions to max(8, the remaining head budget) tokens, silently cuts the state (a string as is, otherwise Python-style json.dumps) to max(0, max_len - length so far - 1) tokens, cuts the whole sequence to max_len and drops markers at or beyond it; options render as "key: description" or "key" (choice), "level <i>: <text>" (score) and "false: <text>", "true: <text>" with defaults "no, the statement does not hold" and "yes, the statement holds" (noul)

@receptron/laya 0.1.2 dist/laya.js systemOne(state, questions) requires at least one question and throws when a question's markers do not match its options; it feeds input_ids int64 [n, L] right-padded with [PAD], attention_mask int64 [n, L], marker_pos int64 [n, K], marker_mask bool [n, K] and qtype int64 [n] (choice 0, score 1, noul 2), throws unless logits and act_probs are float32, divides each row's logits by temperature_by_options["<type>:<2, 3-5, 6-10 or 11+>"] or else temperature[qtype] or else 1, applies softmax, and answers noul as round4(p[1]), score as round4(sum of i * p[i]) and choice as the most probable option, with round4 probabilities, confidence 1 - normalized entropy and rl_agent.act_probability from act_probs; usage is input_tokens = the sum of the already-cut sequence lengths and output_tokens = 0, and model is "laya"
